definitions.explanation: A microorganism — such as a virus, bacterium, or parasite — that causes disease. A general scientific and medical term covering all types of infectious agents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{病原体|びょうげんたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{病原体|びょうげんたい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{空気|くうき}{感染|かんせん}→空気感染：25169_kuukikansen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This pathogen is transmitted through the air.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手洗|てあら}い→手洗い：12761_tearai⟧や⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{病原体|びょうげんたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基本的|きほんてき}→基本的：04787_kihonteki⟧な⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧だ。
examples.english: Handwashing and masks are basic measures to prevent the spread of pathogens.

notes:
Composed of {病原|びょうげん} (cause of disease) + ⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧ (body, entity). A formal scientific term that became much more widely known through news coverage of infectious disease outbreaks.
